body.message:
For cash payments, you will need to visit our main office. Please note that the office will be open only on Monday as it is closed during the weekend.

Kindly note that without payment, we are unable to block the unit. We recommend confirming with us again on Monday, as the unit is listed on multiple platforms and availability may change at any time.

If it is still available, you are welcome to come to our main office to proceed with the payment and booking.
